name: SpeedPad
brief: A speed pad course: a floor with a SpawnLocation and a glowing speed pad. Stepping on the pad doubles the player's WalkSpeed to 32 for 10 seconds.
contract: The pad is a Part named SpeedPad on the floor.
Touching SpeedPad sets the touching player's Humanoid.WalkSpeed to 32, and back to 16 after 10 seconds.
